messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image, using the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image. Use the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands facing forward, then turns and raises both arms overhead in a stretching or dancing motion before lowering them and turning back to face the camera.","camera":"A full-body shot at a low angle that slowly orbits around the character, shifting from a front view to side and back views.","clothing":"A short, white dress with a pink and green floral pattern, cold-shoulder cutouts, and a V-neckline, paired with pink slip-on shoes.","hair_color":"Bright yellow-blonde.","hairstyle":"Short, straight blonde hair with blunt bangs and small rounded side sections.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slim build, dark skin, and large gold hoop earrings.","scene":"An outdoor paved area beneath a large wooden overpass or bridge structure, with parked cars, street signs, and a bright sky visible in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background was changed from a sunlit stone pier with water and buildings to a paved area beneath a large wooden overpass/bridge, with street signs, barriers, parked vehicles, and bright sky visible. The character, yellow-blonde hair, floral dress, pink shoes, and stretching/turning action remain largely consistent, and the camera continues a low-angle full-body orbit.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the original outdoor stone-pier scene with the reference environment under a wooden overpass/bridge, while preserving the same character, hairstyle, outfit, expression, action, and camera framing/movement, with natural lighting.
uncertain: Whether the exact reference camera framing was fully matched, since the output includes a moving orbit rather than a single static reference frame.
unexpected_changes: The new scene is much darker under the overpass, changing the overall lighting and contrast compared with the bright source scene.
The character's face is less clearly visible in several frames due to the darker environment and angle.
